primary_estimand.population: all preregistered confirmatory base_scenario_id units eligible under the frozen benchmark/oracle contract with frozen source-family and model-profile allocation
primary_estimand.arm_binding_rule: exact executable arm IDs and factor vectors are imported from accepted WP-004 before final N/confirmatory freeze; best-DEV-arm selection is forbidden
primary_estimand.contrast: P(treatment_correct)-P(control_correct) over equally weighted base_scenario_id units under frozen target-population allocation

observation_nesting.response_level_publication_composite: all publication-critical applicable scorer fields correct

primary_analysis.point_estimate: mean paired base_scenario_id treatment-minus-control scenario_level_exact_epistemic_contract_accuracy difference under frozen target-population weights
primary_analysis.variance: CR1 source-family cluster-robust sandwich variance for intercept-only paired differences
primary_analysis.small_cluster_rule: if fewer than 30 independent source-family clusters remain, primary PASS is prohibited and a separately preregistered finite-cluster method is required before confirmatory scoring
primary_analysis.type_I_calibration: simulation under null at the minimum 30-cluster boundary must satisfy the frozen Monte-Carlo Type-I gate before sample-size acceptance

publication_composite.rule: correct only when every publication-critical applicable field is correct before frozen repeat/paraphrase aggregation
publication_composite.declared_runtime_or_model_failure: incorrect; never converted to missing for the primary endpoint
publication_composite.pre_split_construction_ineligibility: excluded before split assignment under the benchmark construction contract and not called runtime attrition

HOLDOUT.success: two-sided cluster-robust p<0.05 and point estimate > 0; full interval and SESOI comparison reported

REPLICATION.role: independently sourced directional and interval replication
REPLICATION.success: point estimate > 0 with full cluster-robust interval reported; significance is reported but not required by the frozen replication success rule

joint_success.rule: HOLDOUT success AND independently sourced REPLICATION success
joint_success.power_method: independent paired simulation of both confirmatory sets under the same frozen design assumptions; sample-size recommendation must satisfy the joint Monte-Carlo lower-bound gate

multiplicity.secondary_family: Holm step-down at familywise alpha 0.05 within each accepted family
multiplicity.exploratory: reported with effect sizes and uncertainty, explicitly non-confirmatory

selection_prohibitions: choose treatment arm by best DEV composite result
choose baseline by weakest DEV result
change SESOI after observing directional treatment difference
change alpha or target power after observing results
drop difficult source families to reach significance
replace final endpoint with a favorable field-level endpoint
treat publication_composite_correctness as a second primary endpoint instead of a legacy response-level alias
treat paraphrases repeats training seeds or infrastructure reruns as extra independent base scenarios
treat secondary or exploratory significance as the preregistered primary claim
